notes: Fixes from a full review: QR codes in setup and on the home page no longer depend on an outside website
Today & tomorrow on a tablet: the weekend list is one column so names aren’t cut short; a repeating event on Saturday and Sunday shows on both days
When to show: times are checked properly (24-hour clock, 24:00 for midnight)
When to show: the widget shown at other times has to be the same height (half with half, full with full)
Any widget can show only on certain days and times, with another widget in its space the rest of the time (Family Admin → Screen → the widget → When to show)
Trains: disruption messages only about your route, all of them, or off
